label: e04-rate-proposed-as-count
title: A capacity rate proposed as a month's output

propositions.why: Changed from v1 (HOLD, period missing). 46,000 units/month is a capacity rate, not units produced in some month; asking which month would invite one to be invented. The admissible proposition is a capacity_rate claim (v03), which is a different proposal.

reads.why: The refused proposal is not re-typed into a capacity record.
